title: Unable to reset password
description: Customer does not receive the password reset email after several attempts.

title: Payment failed at checkout
description: Customer receives a payment declined message despite having a valid card.

title: Account access locked
description: Customer is locked out after too many sign-in attempts and cannot access the account.

title: Regional service outage
description: Customer cannot access the support portal during a regional service interruption.

title: Password reset link expired
description: The password reset link expires immediately after the customer opens it.

title: Duplicate payment charge
description: Customer was charged twice for the same monthly subscription renewal.

title: Unable to update account email
description: Customer receives an error when saving a new email address on the account.

title: Mobile account access issue
description: Customer can sign in on the website but receives an error in the mobile application.

title: Service outage notification delay
description: Customer did not receive an outage notification during a regional interruption.

title: Critical account access failure
description: Customer cannot access the account and the recovery process also fails.

title: Invoice download unavailable
description: Customer cannot download the latest invoice from the billing page.

title: Subscription cancellation error
description: Customer receives an error while trying to cancel a subscription.

title: Unexpected login alert
description: Customer received a login alert for a device they do not recognize.

title: Slow support portal response
description: Pages in the support portal take more than thirty seconds to load.

title: Follow-up on password reset
description: Customer contacted support again because the password reset issue returned.

title: Refund not received
description: Customer has not received an expected refund after the stated processing period.

title: Profile preferences not saving
description: Customer changes notification preferences but the updates are not retained.

title: Data export request pending
description: Customer requested an account data export that has not completed.

title: Service outage caused lost session
description: Customer was signed out during an outage and lost an unsaved support form.
